title: IMS New Zealand to supply international defence force with Cloudburst helicopter firefighting equipment
summary: Working in partnership with TKOF Aviation, IMS New Zealand will deliver 11 3,500-liter Cloudburst Fire Buckets, along with a full suite of supporting aerial firefighting equipment.
body_markdown:
IMS New Zealand Ltd announced it has been awarded a large contract to supply a defence force in Latin America with a comprehensive range of aerial firefighting equipment, significantly enhancing the country’s capability and preparedness for wildfire response.


The contract followed a competitive public tender process, in which Cloudburst was evaluated against other aerial firefighting bucket systems on the market and selected as the successful supplier.


IMS New Zealand Photo


Working in partnership with TKOF Aviation, based out of Chile, IMS New Zealand will deliver 11 3,500-liter Cloudburst Fire Buckets, along with a full suite of supporting aerial firefighting equipment.


Cloudburst Fire Buckets have built a strong global track record over more than two decades, with buckets operating in demanding environments worldwide.


The equipment has been adopted by military, government, and commercial operators across the Americas, Asia, and beyond, including strong export markets in the United States, Canada, Indonesia, India, Chile, and China.


This latest agreement further strengthens IMS New Zealand’s presence in the global defence and emergency response sector, adding to a growing list of military and government organisations that have adopted Cloudburst systems.


The continued uptake reflects increasing global awareness of wildfire risk and the importance of investing in reliable, proven aerial firefighting solutions.


IMS New Zealand Photo


IMS New Zealand representative Declan Monteith commented: “It is encouraging to see more countries around the world taking the threat of wildfires seriously and investing in proven aerial firefighting solutions. This contract reflects the trust placed in our equipment to perform in demanding environments and support critical operations. We are proud to support this defence force as they continue to build their aerial firefighting capability.”


IMS New Zealand remains committed to delivering high-quality, reliable aerial firefighting equipment to operators worldwide.


Through ongoing innovation and close collaboration with partners and end users, IMS continues to support safer, more effective wildfire response efforts across the globe.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by IMS New Zealand.*
